name: node-openapi-mock-server
title: Node OpenAPI Mock Server
blurb: Zero-dependency OpenAPI 3 mock server: example-first responses, schema-shaped defaults, 404/405, required param validation.

verify.name: contract
verify.cmd: if curl -s --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5531/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'port 5531 is already answering - stop that process before running this step'; exit 1; fi; PORT=5531 node src/main.js >.openapi-mock.log 2>&1 & srv=$!; ok=1; for _ in $(seq 1 120); do if curl -s --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5531/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=0; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; kill -0 $srv 2>/dev/null || { echo 'the server exited before it answered'; cat .openapi-mock.log; exit 1; }; if [ $ok -ne 0 ]; then cat .openapi-mock.log; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; node tools/contract.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:5531; rc=$?; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; wait $srv 2>/dev/null; test $rc -eq 0
